user.title: Connect to your Bentel Absoluta panel
user.description: Enter the panel's serial number and PIN - the same two values the Absoluta app itself asks for. There's no separate account/login.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-enter your Bentel Absoluta PIN
reauth_confirm.description: The panel rejected the stored PIN - it may have been changed on the panel itself.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the panel. If it's currently connected via the mobile app, try again shortly.
error.invalid_auth: The serial or PIN was rejected by the panel.

error.snapshot_interval_too_low: The full status refresh interval is too low - a short interval means this integration opens a session on the panel more often, which can interrupt the mobile app's own connection.
